data.name: Vivie
data.gender_notes: Vivie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'zoe', meaning 'life'. This name symbolizes the spirit of vitality and the essence of being. It was a popular name in the Byzantine Empire and is still used in the Christian world. The name Vivie carries the meaning “Alive, Full of Life” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vivie usually hope their child will grow to embody alive, full of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
